title: Caleb and the sea shanty

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: Morse code. We're salty that way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Morse code. We're salty that way.

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: The edge of the Sump. A wall that stretched as far as you could see to East and West. A wall that surrounds all of Nivalis and the lands that surround the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The edge of the Sump. A wall that stretched as far as you could see to East and West. A wall that surrounds all of Nivalis and the lands that surround the city.

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: No, it's worse than that. Nivalis sits atop a mighty plateau, artificial, filled with water and surrounded by a wall to keep the waves in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, it's worse than that. Nivalis sits atop a mighty plateau, artificial, filled with water and surrounded by a wall to keep the waves in.

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: Well Mariner, your quest is at an end. Did you find the answers you were looking for on the high seas?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well Mariner, your quest is at an end. Did you find the answers you were looking for on the high seas?

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: That's the ocean for ya. You'll find answers out there, but maybe not to the questions you asked. So... anything else, or you all done with me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's the ocean for ya. You'll find answers out there, but maybe not to the questions you asked. So... anything else, or you all done with me?

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: It's a song for the Captain. An old sea shanty. If you'd care to hear it, I can give it a go. The old pipes might struggle... But we can try.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a song for the Captain. An old sea shanty. If you'd care to hear it, I can give it a go. The old pipes might struggle... But we can try.

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: I know why you are here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know why you are here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You do?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You do?

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: We're talking again. Both Crabface and that old fucker Salt Pete have messaged me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're talking again. Both Crabface and that old fucker Salt Pete have messaged me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you message them? Comms are down.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you message them? Comms are down.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you message them? Comms are down.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you message them? Comms are down.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So can you tell me the truth about The Gridless Sea?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So can you tell me the truth about The Gridless Sea?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So can you tell me the truth about The Gridless Sea?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So can you tell me the truth about The Gridless Sea?

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: Old Salt Pete didn't tell you? I guess he has grown a bit wiser over the millennia.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Old Salt Pete didn't tell you? I guess he has grown a bit wiser over the millennia.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: We did it! We reunited the pirate gang!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We did it! We reunited the pirate gang!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you tell me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you tell me?

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: I can tell you what he saw, sure. Though he's wrong. He MUST be wrong... or CORA help us all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can tell you what he saw, sure. Though he's wrong. He MUST be wrong... or CORA help us all.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I've come this far.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've come this far.

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: Salt Pete had a theory, and on that stormy night, just before we lost the Captain, he found evidence that his theory was correct. We didn't see it, but he is sure he did.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Salt Pete had a theory, and on that stormy night, just before we lost the Captain, he found evidence that his theory was correct. We didn't see it, but he is sure he did.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: See what?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See what?

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: The end of The Gridless Sea. Beyond the reaches of Nivalis, beyond the electromagnetic waves and the hulking machinery of this ancient city, Salt Pete saw the edge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The end of The Gridless Sea. Beyond the reaches of Nivalis, beyond the electromagnetic waves and the hulking machinery of this ancient city, Salt Pete saw the edge.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The... "edge?"

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The... "edge?"

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So Nivalis is surrounded by a wall?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So Nivalis is surrounded by a wall?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So Nivalis is surrounded by a wall?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So Nivalis is surrounded by a wall?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That sounds like...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sounds like...

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: Yes, a Sump. A mighty artificial pool, put there by who knows, and for what? Is there anything below? Why are we in it? Who put us here? Is it to protect us, or a prison? The possibilities are fascinating... but terrifying.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, a Sump. A mighty artificial pool, put there by who knows, and for what? Is there anything below? Why are we in it? Who put us here? Is it to protect us, or a prison? The possibilities are fascinating... but terrifying.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seems hard to believe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seems hard to believe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if he's right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if he's right?

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: It seems hard to imagine the world we live in, and all our perceivable reality exists in a... "bath." But Salt Pete was convinced that was our reality - and that's not where his crazy ideas ended.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It seems hard to imagine the world we live in, and all our perceivable reality exists in a... "bath." But Salt Pete was convinced that was our reality - and that's not where his crazy ideas ended.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: He believed there was a plug, and he wanted to pull it out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He believed there was a plug, and he wanted to pull it out.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't believe it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't believe it.

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: Me neither. I mean surely the people who travel to Luna would look back and see us? We have satellites too. But... who knows? Perhaps there are people in power who hide the truth from us. You can hardly look out the window when flying to Luna.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me neither. I mean surely the people who travel to Luna would look back and see us? We have satellites too. But... who knows? Perhaps there are people in power who hide the truth from us. You can hardly look out the window when flying to Luna.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hmmm...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: In a way.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In a way.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not exactly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Crabface said to tell you "Stormy's Gone."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Crabface said to tell you "Stormy's Gone."
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Crabface said to tell you "Stormy's Gone."
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Crabface said to tell you "Stormy's Gone."

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text: Ah. Well, maybe once more. For old times sake. For the Captain.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah. Well, maybe once more. For old times sake. For the Captain.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sure.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure.

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text:
Stormy's Gone, the good old bot

Way, Way Stormalong

Old Stormy is dead and gone

Way, hay, Captain Marquez

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Stormy's Gone, the good old bot

Way, Way Stormalong

Old Stormy is dead and gone

Way, hay, Captain Marquez

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text:
Of all old skippers she was best

But now she's dead and gone to rest

She battered the mast off the Nivalis Horn

Close by the place she was born

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Of all old skippers she was best

But now she's dead and gone to rest

She battered the mast off the Nivalis Horn

Close by the place she was born

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text:
We dug her grave with silver spade

Her shroud of triple polymers made

We lowered her down with a titanium chain

Our eyes wet with more than rain

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
We dug her grave with silver spade

Her shroud of triple polymers made

We lowered her down with a titanium chain

Our eyes wet with more than rain

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text:
An able skipper bold and true

A good old skipper to her crew

For a thousand years she sailed the seas

In winter gale and summer breeze

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
An able skipper bold and true

A good old skipper to her crew

For a thousand years she sailed the seas

In winter gale and summer breeze

nodes.speaker: Caleb Foamheart
nodes.text:
Old Stormy was a sailor bold

A Grand Old Sailor from days of old

And a friend to the end when the sun grows cold

Old Stormy was a sailor bold...

pronounText.TextHeVersion:
Old Stormy was a sailor bold

A Grand Old Sailor from days of old

And a friend to the end when the sun grows cold

Old Stormy was a sailor bold...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Goodbye Old Stormy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye Old Stormy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Have you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I guess that's good news.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I guess that's good news.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're kidding, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're kidding, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't get it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't get it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll be honored!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll be honored!
